summary: Flutterwave v4 payout provider tested end-to-end against the real sandbox. Backend: 14/14 pass (13 API + 1 dispatch/reconcile integration). GET /payouts/banks NG = live, 598 banks, id==code, Access Bank 044. resolve-account 044/0690000031 -> 'Ajadi Jackson'. A non-numeric bank code -> 404. NOTE: the FLW sandbox returns 'Ajadi Jackson' for ANY numeric account/bank combination, so a 'wrong account number' 404 can't be shown in sandbox. This is how the sandbox behaves, not an app bug. /app/config shows provider=flutterwave/Flutterwave. Admin GET shows flutterwave probe ok with countries GH,KE,NG,RW,TZ,UG, and the kotani/bogus switch, 400 on a bad provider and switch back all work. dispatch_payout_for_remit NG (044/0690000031) and KE (254712345678) created real sandbox transfers (provider flutterwave, mode live, sandbox true, trf_...). reconcile_flutterwave() settled both on the first pass (payout.status SUCCESSFUL). Test rows were cleaned up. Remit quote NG/KE and corridors still work. Frontend: the Nigeria remit with Card funding loads the Flutterwave bank list, search works, and picking Access Bank and typing 0690000031 shows 'Ajadi Jackson'. Admin Payout partner card shows Flutterwave ACTIVE + 'Connected — Connected (598 NG banks)'. Final state: provider=flutterwave, beta_test_mode=true.

minor.issue: The Flutterwave NG list has a duplicate code 044 (two 'Access Bank' rows, plus a third 'Access Bank' with another code). 7 names have leading or trailing spaces (e.g. ' AL-Barakah Microfinance Bank') and 26 names are duplicated. On the frontend this causes React 'two children with the same key' warnings and duplicate testIDs (ng-bank-044 x3 in the DOM). Fix: dedupe by code, strip() names, and show the code next to banks that share a name.

When provider == 'flutterwave' the code falls into the else branch and calls kotani.offramp_rate. Kotani returns 'not authorized', so quotes fall back to 'estimated'. It works by accident, but the rate comes from Kotani or an estimate, not Flutterwave. Add an explicit flutterwave branch (estimated or the FLW rates endpoint) and stop calling Kotani.

The reference is 'vlt' + id.replace('-','')[:28]. FLW requires it to be alphanumeric. This is fine for uuid4 ids, but any id with '_' or other characters fails with 400 'reference must be an alphanumeric string' (reproduced with a TEST_ id). Then in beta it silently falls back to a simulated payout. Sanitize with re.sub('[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', ...).

Rows whose payout_status keeps failing (e.g. reference_id None or an unknown trf) are never marked and stay in the limit(25) window forever. Enough of them would starve newer transfers. Add an attempts counter/age cutoff or sort by initiated_at.
The cached token is not cleared on a 401 response, so a revoked token keeps failing until it expires (max 10 min). Clear _token when the status is 401.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate keys/testIDs for bank code 044 (3 'Access Bank' rows that can't be told apart; console 'Encountered two children with the same key'). The user can't tell which Access Bank is which.
Probe line reads 'Connected — Connected (598 NG banks)'. The UI adds 'Connected — ' in front of a backend detail that already starts with 'Connected'.

action_items: Dedupe the Flutterwave bank list by code and trim names in flutterwave.list_banks. Optionally show the code for banks that share a name.
Add an explicit flutterwave branch in payouts.partner_offramp_quote so Kotani isn't called when Flutterwave is active.
Strip non-alphanumeric characters from the FLW transfer reference in _dispatch_flutterwave.
Remove the duplicate 'Connected — ' prefix in PayoutProviderCard (or change the backend probe detail).

Update stale docstrings/comments that still mention Yellow Card / 'Kotani ↔ Yellow Card' (payouts.py header, payouts_router.py payout_banks docstring, NgBankFields.tsx header, PayoutProviderCard.tsx header).
critical_code_review_comments: payouts.partner_offramp_quote: flutterwave falls into the Kotani branch.
reconcile_flutterwave: no backoff or attempts limit for transfers that never resolve.
flutterwave.create_payout rounds UGX/RWF/TZS amounts to 2 decimals. These currencies are usually whole numbers, so check that FLW accepts decimals for them.
list_banks returns mode 'live' with an empty list on auth or network failure, so the frontend shows an empty picker with no error message.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (2 minor UI issues)
